packageRules.description: Majors wait 30 days, then sit on the Dependency Dashboard until ticked there; they never open a PR on their own. Once ticked, the weekly schedule is skipped: approving one is a request to see it now.

Every minor and patch update lands in one weekly PR, so there is one review a week instead of a stream of small ones. This also keeps the packages that move together in step (the Mastra packages, ai plus the @ai-sdk/* providers, the React and Next monorepos). @mastra/otel-exporter stays out: it is pinned (1.3.11+ crashed at import), and a bad version must not hold back the whole batch.

TypeScript 7: typescript-eslint peers on '>=4.8.4 <6.1.0' and hard-errors with 'typescript-eslint does not support TS 7.0'. tsc itself passes clean on 7.0.2 under Next 16 — only the lint toolchain blocks it. Track typescript-eslint#10940 and drop this rule when it ships TS 7 support.

ESLint 10: eslint-plugin-react 7.37.5 peers on '<=^9.7' and crashes on the removed context.getFilename API. eslint-config-next depends on it, so this unblocks only when that plugin ships ESLint 10 support.
@types/node tracks the Node major the Dockerfile actually runs (24 LTS), not the newest published types.
